name: Duct Tape
text: Wild: counts as any part in a meld. Consumed when used in a build.

name: Bulk Pack
text: In a set, counts as two copies of the set's part. Not usable in runs.

name: Adaptor
text: Add to a meld: one part in that meld counts as an adjacent gauge or a different category.

name: Toolbox
text: When drawn (or played): draw 2, keep 1. The other is discarded.

name: Parts Catalogue
text: Play: look at the top 3 cards of your deck and reorder them.

name: Scavenger
text: Play: take any card from the discard pile into your hand.

name: Scrapyard
text: Play: permanently remove a card in your hand from your deck. Scrapyard is used up.
